forms.detail: EMCDDA: small, pressurised metal cartridges containing 8 grams of liquid nitrous oxide, also called canisters, bulbs or whippets.
EMCDDA: larger cylinders sold in sizes from 0.58 to 15 kg.

EMCDDA: a prescription-only medical analgesic and anaesthetic gas (always given mixed with oxygen); a food additive and aerosol propellant for whipped cream; also a refrigerant, leak-detecting agent, oxidising agent and chemical reagent, used in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing and as a fuel additive in car racing. WHO ATC also lists 'nitrous oxide, combinations' (N01AX63).
